findings.current: When I came to, there was blood everywhere.
findings.defect: The source describes the surroundings as a sea of blood (피바다), a stronger, specific image than simply blood being everywhere. The accepted baseline preserved that image.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 사방이 피바다였다: all around him was a sea of blood.
findings.replacement: When I opened my eyes again, it was a sea of blood all around me.

findings.current: Only then did a faint smile touch Team Leader Choi’s lips.
findings.defect: The English omits that Choi’s faint smile came in response to Taekyung’s banter.
findings.rationale: 내 너스레에 explicitly links the smile to Taekyung’s lighthearted remark.
findings.replacement: My banter finally brought a faint smile to Team Leader Choi’s lips.

summary: Two minor omissions soften source-specific imagery and the stated reaction to Taekyung’s banter.
